Subject: Action needed: confirm your student account before enrolment closes
Hi, as part of this term's systems upgrade, all student accounts must be re-confirmed by Friday. Please sign in through the secure portal at https://uowd-student-portal-confirm.com/login so your timetable and Moodle access are not interrupted. IT Service Desk

Subject: Invoice INV-20931 overdue
Good morning, our records show that invoice INV-20931 for your recent order remains unpaid. To avoid a late fee, please settle the balance today using the payment link below. https://billing-docs-share.com/inv/20931 Kind regards, Accounts Receivable

Subject: Shared document: Q3 salary adjustments
Hello, HR has shared 'Q3 Salary Adjustments.xlsx' with you. The file is available for 48 hours. Open it with your Microsoft 365 credentials here: https://sharepoint-online-docs.net/view?id=88213

Subject: Unusual sign-in attempt blocked
We noticed a sign-in attempt to your Apple ID from a new device in Lagos. If this was not you, please secure your account immediately at http://appleid.apple.com.security-check-id.info/verify and confirm your payment information.

Subject: Your refund is ready
Dear customer, after reviewing your tax return we have determined that you are eligible for a refund of AED 1,840. Please submit your card details through our refund form within 3 days to receive the transfer: https://tax-refund-claims.org/form

Subject: Quick favour
Hi, are you at your desk? I am in a meeting and need you to buy four Apple gift cards for a client today. Please send me the codes as soon as you have them. I will reimburse you this afternoon. Thanks

Subject: Mailbox storage almost full
Your mailbox has reached 98% of its storage limit. Messages sent to you will be returned to the sender. Increase your storage for free by validating your account here: https://mail-quota-upgrade.com/owa

Subject: Delivery attempt failed
We tried to deliver your package today but no one was available. To reschedule delivery, please pay the redelivery fee of 9.50 using the link below. Your parcel will be returned after 48 hours. https://dhl-redelivery-service.com/track
Aramex: your shipment is on hold due to an unpaid customs fee of 12 AED. Pay now to release it: aramex-customs-fee.com/pay
Emirates NBD: your card has been temporarily blocked. Verify your identity to restore access: enbd-secure-verify.com
Hi mum, I dropped my phone and this is my new number. Can you send me 500 for rent today? I will pay you back next week x
Your Netflix membership could not be renewed. Update your payment details within 24 hours to avoid suspension: netflix-billing-update.net
RTA: You have an unpaid traffic fine. Settle it today to avoid a penalty: rta-fines-portal.com
Congratulations! Your number was selected in the Etisalat anniversary draw. Claim your iPhone at etisalat-rewards-claim.com before midnight.
Your WhatsApp verification code was requested on a new device. If this wasn't you, secure your account: whatsapp-account-secure.com
Microsoft: unusual activity was detected on your account. Reply with the 6-digit code we sent to keep your account active.

Subject: Your order has shipped
Hi Sara, good news: your order #114-2231 has shipped and should arrive on Thursday. You can track it in the app under Your Orders. Thanks for shopping with us.

Subject: CSIT305 group meeting moved
Hi all, the group meeting is moved to Wednesday 2pm in room 3.14 because of the quiz. Please bring your draft sections so we can merge them. Cheers, Imad

Subject: Your monthly statement is available
Your October e-statement is now available. For your security we never ask for your password or PIN by email. Log in to the banking app as usual to view it.

Subject: Library loan due soon
This is a reminder that the book 'Introduction to Machine Learning' is due back on 4 November. You can renew it online from your library account.

Subject: Password changed
The password for your account was changed on 28 October at 09:14. If you made this change, no action is needed. If not, please contact the IT Service Desk on the number on the university website.

Subject: Invoice for October
Hi, please find attached the invoice for the October design work as agreed. Payment terms are 30 days. Let me know if you need anything changed. Best, Omar

Subject: Reminder: assessment submission
Dear students, a reminder that the project submission is due on Sunday at 11:59pm via the Assessment Hub. Late submissions follow the policy in the subject outline. Regards, Ms. Bhagwat

Subject: Thanks for your feedback
Thank you for completing our customer survey last week. Your feedback helps us improve our service. You do not need to do anything else.
